text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Orange: AC capacity. Blue: DC capacity (AC times an assumed ratio of 1.1 to 1.5). Line: median. Band: 10th to 90th percentile. Fits use rows before 2026-07-01; D18 has data only from 2025-03-01 and is report-only.'
text.tspan: Orange: AC capacity. Blue: DC capacity (AC times an assumed ratio of 1.1 to 1.5).
Line: median. Band: 10th to 90th percentile. Fits use rows before 2026-07-01;
D18 has data only from 2025-03-01 and is report-only.
